item.text: I’m checking a few primary and Reuters sources for the 2024 crisis-management record, especially inflation, earthquake recovery, and policy correction. Then I’ll synthesize only the strongest claim-level items.

item.text:
Mixed, leaning slightly positive on stabilization and crisis repair, but negative on honesty/consistency. The best evidence shows Erdoğan’s team moved toward orthodox stabilization in 2024, yet the record still includes politicized policy management, sharp living-standard losses, and property-rights shocks that hurt crisis credibility.

| Polarity | Title | Publisher | Date | URL | Claim-level summary | IDs |
|---|---|---:|---|---|---|---|
| Positive | Turkiye: 2024 Article IV Mission Press Release | IMF | 2024-08-28 | https://www.imf.org/en/news/articles/2024/08/28/pr24311-turkiye-2024-article-iv-mission-press-release | IMF said the policy turnaround since mid-2023 sharply reduced crisis risks, improved reserves, and started easing inflation; it also said tighter policy and fiscal restraint were restoring confidence. This is strong evidence of competent shock management. | 5B.9, 5B.3, 5B.7 |
| Positive | Republic of Türkiye: 2024 Article IV Consultation-Press Release; Staff Report; and Statement by the Executive Director for the Republic of Türkiye | IMF | 2024-10-11 | https://www.imf.org/en/publications/cr/issues/2024/10/11/republic-of-trkiye-2024-article-iv-consultation-press-release-staff-report-and-statement-by-556139 | IMF’s board said tax and expenditure measures strengthened credibility and reduced imbalances, while encouraging further fiscal and monetary coordination. This supports a reading of policy correction rather than denial. | 5B.9, 5B.3, 5B.7 |
| Positive | Turkey central bank stuns market with 500-point rate hike to 50% | Reuters | 2024-03-21 | https://www.marketscreener.com/news/latest/Turkey-central-bank-stuns-market-with-500-point-rate-hike-to-50--46253265/ | The CBRT’s pre-election hike was read as a sign of independence from short-term political pressure. That suggests a real attempt to confront inflation with evidence-based tightening. | 5B.9, 5B.2, 5B.3, 5B.7 |
| Positive | Turkey completes new homes in area hit by devastating earthquake | Reuters | 2024-02-03 | https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/turkey-completes-new-homes-in-area-hit-by-devastating-earthquake-3291916 | Erdoğan’s government handed over 7,275 homes in Hatay and promised more reconstruction. This is concrete crisis-response spending and partial recovery management. | 5B.9, 5B.6, 5B.8 |
| Negative | Dark days for Turks as Erdogan atones for economic errors | Reuters | 2024-07-18 | https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/dark-days-for-turks-as-erdogan-atones-for-economic-errors-2024-07-18/ | Reuters described six years of punishing inflation and a sharp credit clampdown that damaged living standards. This is strong evidence that earlier mistakes imposed real costs and that the recovery was late and painful. | 5B.9, 5B.3, 5B.7 |
| Negative | Shock and confusion as Turkey seizes properties from earthquake survivors | Reuters | 2024-03-18 | https://www.reuters.com/commodities/shock-confusion-turkey-seizes-earthquake-survivors-homes-2024-03-18/ | Reuters reported deeds in Hatay being transferred to the Treasury under an urban-transformation amendment, alarming survivors. That is a major property-rights and crisis-honesty failure. | 5B.9, 5B.4, 5B.6, 5B.8 |
| Negative | Turkey to lift minimum retirement pay, impose minimum corporate tax | Reuters | 2024-07-16 | https://theprint.in/world/turkey-to-lift-minimum-retirement-pay-impose-minimum-corporate-tax/2176793/ | The package looks like targeted relief and political management rather than a broad structural fix. It helps some households, but it reads more like short-term stabilization of discontent than candid crisis repair. | 5B.9, 5B.7, 5B.8 |
| Negative | Turkey’s revolving door: Five years, six central bank chiefs | Reuters | 2024-02-05 | https://www.marketscreener.com/news/latest/Turkey-s-revolving-door-Five-years-six-central-bank-chiefs-45882771/ | Reuters noted Erdoğan had fired the last four central bank governors and that credibility had been badly damaged. That is strong evidence against durable, honest crisis management because policy depended on presidential discretion. | 5B.9, 5B.2, 5B.7, 5B.3 |

Search gap: I found strong evidence on inflation, reserves, credit conditions, and earthquake recovery, but little direct 2024 evidence on unemployment, public debt, or sanctions management specifically. The “honesty” part is mostly inferential from policy behavior and Reuters/IMF framing rather than explicit admissions by Erdoğan.
